name: Zero-Point Energy Storage Substrate
description: A nanostructured material that harvests trace amounts of energy from quantum vacuum fluctuations via the Casimir effect. The energy output is minuscule but perpetual, making ZPE substrates useful for powering ultra-low-power sensors, pacemakers, and long-duration space probes. Claims of high-power ZPE extraction remain fraudulent.
story_hooks: A con artist is selling 'high-output ZPE generators' to desperate Tier 1 communities. The devices are just batteries that drain in a month.
